title: Llama See, Llama Do: A Mechanistic Perspective on Contextual Entrainment and Distraction in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2505.09338v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We observe a novel phenomenon, contextual entrainment, across a wide range of language models (LMs) and prompt settings, providing a new mechanistic perspective on how LMs become distracted by ``irrelevant'' contextual information in the input prompt. Specifically, LMs assign significantly higher logits (or probabilities) to any tokens that have previously appeared in the context prompt, even for random tokens. This suggests that contextual entrainment is a mechanistic phenomenon, occurring independently of the relevance or semantic relation of the tokens to the question or the rest of the sentence. We find statistically significant evidence that the magnitude of contextual entrainment is influenced by semantic factors. Counterfactual prompts have a greater effect compared to factual ones, suggesting that while contextual entrainment is a mechanistic phenomenon, it is modulated by semantic factors. translated_abstract: 我们在广泛的语言模型（LMs）和提示设置中观察到一个新现象——情境牵引，这为语言模型如何被输入提示中的“无关”上下文信息所干扰提供了新的机制性视角。具体而言，语言模型会为之前出现在上下文提示中的任何token赋予显著更高的logits（或概率），即使是随机token也是如此。这表明情境牵引是一种机制性现象，其发生独立于token与问题或句子其余部分的相关性或语义关系。我们发现有统计学显著性的证据表明，情境牵引的强度会受到语义因素的影响。反事实提示相比事实性提示具有更大的影响效果，这说明虽然情境牵引是一种机制性现象，但它会受到语义因素的调节。我们假设存在一个……
tldr: 该论文发现语言模型存在一种“情境牵引”的机制性现象：模型会无差别地提高上下文提示中出现过的任何token（即使是随机token）的输出概率，这一现象独立于语义相关性，但其强度受反事实等语义因素的调节。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals "contextual entrainment," a mechanistic phenomenon in language models where any token previously appearing in the prompt—even random ones—receives significantly higher logits, independent of semantic relevance yet modulated by semantic factors such as counterfactual prompts.
